t: This is 25 North Colonnade in Canary Wharf, a commercial tower eighty metres tall with fifteen floors. It was built in 1991 by the Canary Wharf Group. Its architect was Troughton McAslan, and the practice's John McAslan is the British architect linked to the building. For years it was the home of the Financial Services Authority, which occupied the whole building until early 2013. After that, its successor, the Financial Conduct Authority, used it. Today it is no longer occupied by the regulator.
